method: Own decoder fr_decode.py (beside this file): ffmpeg 8.0.1 CPU, 4 threads, below-normal priority, -copyts coarse seek then select=eq(pts,file_ms) with showinfo after the select; each window refused unless showinfo's pts list equals the request. Frames streamed one at a time; before every window: no Marvel*/obs64 running and free RAM >= 2 GB. frame_index -> composition_ns from frames.csv by pts rank (file_ms = round(pts*1000/120)+21, verified on all 141 owner frames). Decoded-BGR sha256 at 2560x1440 for 1919 frames: all 141 owner review frames (equal 141/141, own_hud flags equal), every 30th frame across the eight owner-accepted segments, every 6th frame through 2 s at each accepted edge plus the frames just outside. Inspected visually as contact sheets (1 s bulk, 0.1 s edges, all owner frames of rejected segments). Snapshot scan.py own-HUD read (hp/max_hp/webs) as a secondary signal only. Raw inputs.jsonl replayed with the evidence's UI key set (T included). Media re-hashed. Decoder slot released to admission-codex after decoding; no further decode.
findings: No spectate, kill cam, death screen, respawn wait, menu, scoreboard, emote wheel or splash inside any accepted segment. Every accepted end is own play at low hp (9, 26, 8, 13, 1, 30-33) or the Tab/Alt press; every accepted start is own play at 250/250.
seg-041 (dead) and seg-029 (no_range_hud) are conservative rule cuts over spans native frames show as own play; not blocking.
Judgement call: seg-030 297.70-297.90 s is a grab/crowd-control close-up on his own body inside an accepted segment; judged own camera (own HUD drawn, control resumes).
session_findings: Owner review frames: 141/141 decoded-BGR hashes equal; composition_ns and file_ms equal frames.csv by pts.
Devices: one keyboard (1840451255, 3142 key packets), one mouse (614403941, 34162 packets); mouse handle 0: 9 packets about 50 s apart, all fields zero (zero-effect).

Rejected spans visually: hero select (seg-000/001), AFK in the setup room, Alt/focus slivers, deaths with the 'DEFEATED BY' spectate panel and teammate HUDs, the Tab scoreboard, dark transition screens, and the post-match MVP/summary screens.
